column1: Table Title: ActiveSG Members' Visits To ActiveSG Gyms By Planning Region, Age Group, Sex, Annual
Region, Sex, Age Group Not Specified

Gym Attendances (Number): Estimated amount of attendees at ActiveSG gyms. Planning Region: Major planning regions of Singapore as defined by the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) of Singapore. The 5 regions are Central Region, East Region, North East Region, North Region and West Region. Sex: Sex of the ActiveSG member. Age Group: ActiveSG members are clustered into four age groups: 13 19, 20 39, 40 59, and 60 years and above. 'Sex Not Specified', 'Age Not Specified' and 'Region, Sex, Age Group Not Specified' refers to records with missing information for the respective dimension. Figures within the age-groups sums up to its respective sex total, which in turn sums up to the planning region totals. Totals may include records with unspecified attributes, where applicable. Data by Planning Region, Sex and Age Group are unavailable for July to December 2024 due to a system transition that affected the capture of these attributes. Visits recorded during this period are reported under 'Region, Sex, Age Group Not Specified'.
Planning Regions refer to areas demarcated in the Urban Redevelopment Authority's Master Plan 2014 for Year 2019 and Master Plan 2019 for Year 2020-2025.
na   not available or not applicable
-     nil or negligible or not significant
Numbers may not add up to the totals due to rounding.
Data are the latest available at the time of access or download. Some statistics, particularly those for the most recent time periods, are provisional and may be subject to revision at a later date.
Values are shown in Singapore dollars (unless otherwise specified).
